node.note: Integration Tests runs the runner twice: with TIER=pr-integration, its integration files, before it starts the API and the workers, and with TIER=live-integration, its live files, after them. chaos.yml runs it too, on a schedule with TIER=pr-integration, and so does nightly.yml's integration-randomized job, on a schedule with TIER=pr-integration and TEST_ORDER=random, once per matrix entry; neither is a required check.

playwright.note: No workflow runs playwright test: the Storybook Stories job installs Chromium for vitest browser mode and runs no spec, so both portals' specs reach no required check.

k6.note: performance.yml's k6-load job runs one scenario per run, on dispatch only, with a name that is an expression of the dispatch input; it is no required check.
